title: LeatherCapHide
description: LeatherCapHide is a Minecraft plugin that makes your name tag invisible to other players when you wear a leather cap. Simply put on the cap, and your username disappears from view
body:
LeatherCapHide

LeatherCapHide is a lightweight Minecraft plugin designed for stealth and fun.

When a player wears a leather cap, their username becomes invisible to others, allowing for sneaky gameplay or just a cool cosmetic effect.

Easy to use, no commands or configuration needed—just put on the cap and vanish pseudo from view!
